A new first-run setup walks you through signing in, choosing your models, checking your microphone and telling Parley who you are. Two fixes also make sure a desktop meeting is not lost.

**New onboarding** (#637)

- It opens with the four steps (record, transcribe, file, hand to AI) and a short demo, then moves on to setup. The language picker is now in the header and also sets the report language.
- Sign in, organization and models are separate steps. You can continue without signing in, join a pending invitation, create an organization or stay personal, and choose Parley-hosted or your own models.
- A microphone check lets you pick the input device and watch the level meter before your first meeting.
- A context step collects your speaker background and dictionary terms. You can seed both from what Claude Code or ChatGPT already remember about you. Nothing is read until you press the button, and the raw text is not stored.
- If you update in the middle of the old wizard, it resumes on the matching step.

**Meetings are no longer lost** (#630, #626)

- A desktop meeting survives a save race, a crash, or a night asleep.
- A meeting that captures no audio no longer redials an empty transcription session every 93 seconds.
